label: Higher when observer believes S2 is good, at D2 on reaching S2, and after reward at D1.
explanation: Raw reset gate r of unit 42 grows strongly with episode time (timing R^2 0.44). Beyond timing it is an S2/a2 signal: it rises as the ideal-observer log-odds favour S2 being good (negative belief_lo) at all phases, jumps at D2 when the reached state is S2 (regardless of choice), and at D1 rises when the reward shown is 1. Previous choice a2 adds little once belief is included. The free fit (prev action, reward by state, ep_dec interactions to capture effects that scale up late in the episode) adds only ~0.015 dev R^2; remaining misses are late-episode windows where effects are multiplicatively larger, and GO after a2 S1 trials is under-predicted. Observed-only; no future variables used.

issues: The label says the reward effect is 'at D1', but it lasts through GO. Changing the third term from (phase==D1)*(in_rew==1) to (phase!=D2)*(prev_reward==1) raises test R^2 beyond timing from 0.553 to 0.590. Applying it at every phase (prev_reward==1) scores worse, 0.525, so the effect is specific to D1 and GO.

The claims about belief and the D2 S2 jump hold up. Dropping the reward term gives 0.480. Using state==2 at all phases instead of D2 only gives 0.479-0.512, so the S2 jump is specific to D2. Replacing the reward term with prev_action==2 adds nothing (0.482), which supports 'previous choice adds little once belief is in'.

A large systematic error remains. Misses shows GO after a2 S1 u under-predicted by +0.078 (still +0.092 with the improved form) and GO after a2 S1 r by +0.060, while D1 after a1 S1 u is over-predicted by -0.052. The GO residual follows the upcoming a2 choice (residual by this choice at GO: a2 about +0.047, a1 about -0.056), which observed-only belief captures only partly. Adding a 4th term (phase==GO)*(prev_action==2) reaches 0.604.

All of the worst-fit windows are late in the episode (t91-99), with actual values well above predicted. Multiplying terms by ep_dec does not fix this (0.523-0.555), so the late-episode scaling is unexplained.
The short form reaches 0.55-0.59, against an observed-only additive ceiling of 0.76, so a sizable part of the explainable variance is still missing.
